title: Bad advice loses weight gradually
hook: The experts’ influence changes after each observed mistake.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Update expert weights multiplicatively and compare cumulative learner loss with the best fixed expert.

misconception: One mistaken prediction should eliminate an expert permanently.
objective: Update expert weights multiplicatively and compare cumulative learner loss with the best fixed expert.

claims.text: Prediction uses normalized weights before seeing that round’s losses. Exponential updates compound each expert’s cumulative loss, so a lower-loss expert receives more influence. The learner’s displayed cumulative mixed loss remains separate from the best fixed expert’s retrospective loss.
